body:
Background- Drugs done: Marijuana, Shrooms, Ritalin, Alcohol, Diphenhydramine, DXM, Tramadol, Ambien, 3-4 Painkillers, + theres probably more, its hard to keep track.
Duloxetine is a painkiller/anti-depressant
+0:00 30mg duloxetine pill is taken
+0:30 small body buzz
+0:45 went to my friends house
+1:00 thought patterns different, noticing things I normally wouldnt
+1:30 remembered I took the pill, and realized that those effects were from it. Body buzz is pleasant.
+2:00 buddy bought some shroom/chocolate mix... And gave me a niblet to show me that it tasted like SOAP. I really dont know how much of it was shrooms, so I'll estimate .5g.
+3:00 body buzz is soothing, perfect. Thoughts become slightly clouded...
+4:00 sleepy time.
The shrooms were a very small dose, and resulted in no hallucinations... Just a mild body buzz. It was soothing when the 2 different body highs came together though... Very nice.
